sections.heading: Description
lines: Flower Garden is one of the fields present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Synthetic field can be found in the Grand Dream Stadium during the tournament and in Castle of Goomidra's garden, during Goomink's sidequest.

sections.heading: Field Stages
lines: This field has 5 stages that it can transform between, with higher stages having more potent effects. The field's stage can be changed via the following methods:
The field grows by 1 stage if one of the following moves is used:
Bloom Doom, Flower Shield, Grassy Terrain, Growth, Ingrain, Rain Dance, Rototiller, Sunny Day, Water Sport
“The garden grew a little!”
Pokémon with the ability Ripen grow the field by 2 stages instead.
The field grows by 1 stage if a Pokémon with one of the following abilities switches in:
Drought, Drizzle, Flower Gift, Flower Veil
“[Pokémon]'s [Ability] grew the garden!”
As of v13.5.6, the field manual incorrectly states that Grassy Surge also increases the field stage.
The field grows by 1 stage if a Synthetic Seed is activated.
“The synthetic seed grew the garden!”
The field is reduced by 1 stage if one of the following moves is used:
Cut, X-Scissor
“The garden was cut down a bit!”
At Stages 3 and above, the field is reduced by 2 stages if one of the following moves is used:
Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume, Mind Blown, Searing Shot
“The garden caught fire!”
As of v13.5.6, despite what the field effect manual says, Water Sport and Rain being active do not prevent the stage from being reduced due to a bug.
The move Acid Downpour resets the field to Stage 1.
“The acid melted the bloom!”

sections.heading: Stage Details
lines: If an effect/move is trailed by an asterisk (*), either it's a new effect or its effect changed from the previous stage.

sections.heading: Stage 1
lines: Abilities Affected:
Flower Gift and Swarm are always activated.
Mimicry changes the user's type to Grass.
Moves Affected: Other moves:
Growth boosts the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages (does not stack with Sun boost).
Rototiller boosts the Attack and Special Attack of affected Pokémon by 2 stages, and additionally affects the user regardless of type.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Grass.
Nature Power becomes Growth.
Secret Power may lower Evasion by 1 stage.
Shelter halves damage from Grass-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Grass.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Synthetic Seed boosts Special Defense and applies Ingrain to the user.
